stories.title: Bahram Vakil will succeed Noel Tata as Trent chairman
stories.summary: Noel Tata steps down as chairman and director of Trent on 11 November after nearly 29 years with the Tata Group retailer. Bahram Vakil takes over from 12 November, and Tata becomes chairman emeritus under the group's governance guidelines.

stories.title: Trent shares jump 7% after Q2 profit rises 25%
stories.summary: Trent stock climbed 6.73% to Rs 3,059 on the BSE after the Zudio and Westside owner reported a 25% rise in consolidated net profit for the September quarter. The rally added about Rs 9,089 crore to its market value.

stories.title: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail more than doubles Q2 profit
stories.summary: ABFRL, which runs Pantaloons and Style Up, reported consolidated net profit of ₹53.05 crore for the September quarter, up from ₹23.44 crore a year earlier. Revenue from operations rose to ₹2,265.61 crore from ₹2,037.90 crore.

stories.title: Ratnadeep Retail gets Sebi nod for its IPO
stories.summary: The Hyderabad value fashion retailer plans a fresh issue of up to Rs 400 crore plus an offer for sale of 1.49 crore shares by promoters. Rs 260 crore will fund new Ratnadeep and National Mart stores and Rs 40 crore will repay debt.

stories.title: ReplyAll raises ₹9.7 crore for its D2C apparel
stories.summary: The Bengaluru clothing brand closed a pre-Series A round co-led by Sadev Ventures and Atom XVII, with ISV, Long View Ventures, Sparrow and Antler joining. The money goes to fabric research, new categories, retail presence and community building, with repeat customers driving growth.

stories.title: Indian designers are bringing fashion home
stories.summary: Grazia India looks at how Anavila, péro and Rajesh Pratap Singh are moving into linen furnishings, craft textiles and home objects. For some the home has long been part of the practice. For others it is a new commercial avenue for existing design research.

stories.title: Aadyam Handmade opens a store in Gurugram
stories.summary: The Aditya Birla Group's craft social enterprise has opened at Ireo Boulevard in Gurugram, with brand ambassador Sobhita Dhulipala at the launch. The brand sells handcrafted products rooted in Indian artisanal traditions and already has stores in Mumbai, Hyderabad and Delhi.

stories.title: Bhavitha Mandava is among Instagram's 25 Rings Award winners
stories.summary: The 26-year-old model, the first Indian to open a Chanel runway, joins Erling Haaland and 23 other creators as a 2026 Rings Award winner. The award recognises creators who take creative risks and make an impact, regardless of follower counts.

stories.title: DFC Delhi Fashion Week takes Indian handloom to St Petersburg
stories.summary: Delhi Fashion Club showed at the 31st Admiralty Needle fashion, art and design festival in St Petersburg from 19 to 22 October. Harshit Dhingaun led the Indian showcase, which featured Manipur handloom, sustainable Indian design and Meghalaya's Ryndia silk.

stories.title: Swarovski opens a store at DLF Promenade in New Delhi
stories.summary: The Austrian crystal brand has added an outlet at DLF Promenade, carrying its crystal jewellery, watches and accessories. The opening extends Swarovski's presence in India's luxury mall segment, where shoppers can now browse necklaces, earrings, bracelets and rings in person.

stories.title: Hidesign opens a new store in Jaipur
stories.summary: The Indian leather goods brand has opened in Jaipur, adding to its footprint in the region. Hidesign makes handbags, briefcases, wallets and other luxury leather goods. Retail manager Aslam Shaikh invited Jaipur to come and experience handcrafted luxury.

stories.title: Marks and Spencer launches its first festive collection in India
stories.summary: M&S has introduced Your Time to Shine, its first ever festive fashion collection, with occasionwear for men and women. The range mixes earthy shades with brighter festive colours, including jackets and shirts for men and dresses meant to move from day to evening.

stories.title: Skechers expands its Aero running shoes in India
stories.summary: Skechers has added new Aero Burst colourways and more performance footwear for men and women in India for autumn and winter. The series first arrived in India in September 2025, and the expansion lands as the country's running season gets underway.

stories.title: A Warrington start-up dressed a BBC drama in pre-loved South Asian outfits
stories.summary: The Tejori Marketplace, a South Asian fashion start-up backed by Warrington Borough Council's Start and Scale Up Club, supplied clothing for cast and supporting artists on BBC One's The Split Up. Founder Saika is building the business around sustainable wardrobe support.

stories.title: Armani's fashion house weighs who gets the first 15%
stories.summary: Giorgio Armani's will asks heirs to sell 15% of the company by early March 2027, naming LVMH, L'Oréal and EssilorLuxottica as preferred buyers. CEO Giuseppe Marsocci is open to splitting the stake. Advisers value the group at €5 billion to €7 billion.

stories.title: Gucci sales fall 6% as Kering's Q3 revenue stays flat
stories.summary: Kering reported third quarter revenue of EUR 3,345 million, flat on a reported basis and down 1% comparable. Jewellery, eyewear, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta and Brioni helped. The group plans at least 125 net store closures in 2026.

stories.title: Louis Vuitton gets a new brand storytelling chief
stories.summary: Hector Muelas leads Louis Vuitton's global brand storytelling, campaigns and content from 1 November. LVMH reported 2% organic revenue growth for the first nine months, while Fashion and Leather Goods declined in the third quarter amid weaker Chinese luxury demand.

stories.title: Pop Mart's Wang Ning says fashion is about happiness now
stories.summary: At the WWD x SKP Global Fashion and Beauty Summit in Wuhan, Chinese founders discussed selling emotion, culture and lasting value. Wang Ning, behind Labubu, described a path from trends into fashion and a broader promise of beauty and happiness. Labubu was unavailable for comment.

stories.title: Grace Coddington revisits a decade of work in Grace: Now
stories.summary: Published by Phaidon, the book gathers more than 200 photographs from the past ten years, tracing her work since she left her full-time role as creative director of American Vogue in 2016. It revisits her collaborations with leading fashion photographers.

stories.title: VF, Timberland and Bunka Fashion College wrap up a designer programme
stories.summary: VF's Tokyo Design Collective and Timberland concluded a five-month programme with Bunka Fashion College in Japan under the theme Craft Meets Innovation. Students presented five concept projects, which VF hopes will reach its global design network.

stories.title: Maison Balestra wins the 2026 FISMO Confesercenti Fashion Award
stories.summary: The Italian house received the award on 29 October for helping represent and promote made in Italy excellence. Artistic director Sofia Bertolli Balestra accepted it for a maison that interprets its heritage with a contemporary eye.

stories.title: Francesca Miranda made five custom looks for a wedding in Peru
stories.summary: The Colombian designer dressed her daughter-in-law Fernanda Nebreda-Bello for her wedding to Francisco Jassir Miranda in Peru's Sacred Valley, Vogue reports. The couple met at a party in Bogotá in May 2023 across the street from her home.

stories.title: Sky Gold's Q2 profit jumps 93%
stories.summary: Sky Gold and Diamonds reported consolidated revenue of ₹2,390.7 crore for Q2 FY27, up 61%, and net profit of ₹129.4 crore, up 93.2%. Its board approved a QIP raise of up to ₹1,800 crore and the acquisition of Purvi Gems and Jewellery.

stories.title: PMJ Jewels opens a flagship store in Chennai's Anna Nagar
stories.summary: PMJ Jewels has opened a flagship in Anna Nagar, inaugurated by actor and anchor Diya Menon with customers and the brand's state and retail heads present. The launch takes PMJ's retail network past 47 stores as it grows in Tamil Nadu.

stories.title: QWEEN opens its first jewellery store in Noida
stories.summary: The luxury jewellery brand backed by Rosy Blue and Kashikey has opened an experiential store aimed at women. A QWEEN Access Card lets shoppers unlock counters and browse on their own, moving away from glass counters and budget-led selling.

stories.title: Gold ETFs hit a record but Dhanteras shoppers still want jewellery
stories.summary: Global gold ETFs drew a record $31 billion in the third quarter, the World Gold Council says. Jewellery designers in Dubai argue Indian families in the UAE will still buy physical gold for Dhanteras. You cannot wear an ETF.

stories.title: The diamond trade looks to Swiss watches for lessons
stories.summary: A study called The Swiss Parallel, released by DMCC and OriginalLuxury at the Dubai Diamond Conference, compares lab-grown stones to the quartz crisis that nearly wiped out Swiss watchmaking. Former Ben Bridge executive Marc Bridge argues the industry is drawing the wrong lessons.

stories.title: Lab-grown gold may be on its way
stories.summary: San Francisco company Marathon Fusion says it has used nuclear fusion to turn mercury into real, stable gold. Co-founder and CEO Kyle Schiller says the company is on a pathway to do it at scale. Jewellers now have one more thing to worry about.

stories.title: Vietnam's PNJ closes 28 stores and cuts over 1,000 jobs
stories.summary: Phu Nhuan Jewelry opened 10 stores and closed 38 in the third quarter, ending September with 403 outlets. The company also reported higher inventory and lower cash as it met buyback obligations on previously sold products.

stories.title: Christie's Geneva will offer the 24-carat Bulgari Pink
stories.summary: The 1950s Bulgari ring holds a fancy intense pink emerald-cut diamond of 24 carats, estimated at CHF 10 million to 15 million. It leads the Magnificent Jewels sale in Geneva on 10 November, alongside Bhagat bangles and a Lalique pendant.

stories.title: DiamondTok turns loose diamonds into impulse buys
stories.summary: JCK looks at live TikTok auctions where bidders snap up loose diamonds in rapid rounds, sometimes collecting stones by the dozen. Buying a diamond once involved grading reports and several store visits. Now it can involve someone yelling at you on a phone.

stories.title: Jewellery designers are betting on the mahjong boom
stories.summary: Maria Ress of Maison Kastel, Heather B Moore and Andrea Brody of Karma and Luck have added mahjong-themed pieces after client requests. Yelp named the game a top trend of 2026, with mahjong club searches up 4,467% year over year.

stories.title: Jewelers for Children names its 2027 Facets honorees
stories.summary: Sarin Bachmann of RX's jewellery portfolio and Julie Walsh of Macy's will be honoured at the 28th Facets fundraiser. The event supports children in need and takes place on 6 June 2027 at The Venetian Resort in Las Vegas.

stories.title: 41,000-year-old shell jewellery found in Russia
stories.summary: Around 50 shell ornaments, some from the Black Sea region, turned up in the oldest layer of the Kostenki 14 site on the Don River near Voronezh. Archaeologists say they point to long-distance links among Europe's earliest Homo sapiens. Accessorising has a long history.

stories.title: Nebula by Titan opens its first boutique in Mumbai
stories.summary: The 18K gold watch brand has opened a 2,000 sq ft standalone store in Khar, the first exclusive boutique in Titan's Premium Collection portfolio. Karan Johar and Karisma Kapoor inaugurated it. The design draws on celestial themes from Nebula's identity.

stories.title: India's eyewear market could nearly double by FY30
stories.summary: Redseer research cited in Lenskart's prospectus puts India's eyewear market at about ₹788 billion in FY25, rising to about ₹1.48 trillion by FY30. Prescription glasses make up around 73% of it, and independent opticians still lead a fragmented market.

stories.title: Just Watches opens a store on Ahmedabad's CG Road
stories.summary: Timex Group India's multi-brand chain has opened at Shajanand Complex with Timex, Daniel Wellington, Versace, Aston Martin, GUESS and Gc watches. Managing director Deepak Chhabra says India's premium watch market continues to present strong opportunities.

stories.title: A Sreeleathers heir builds a separate footwear label
stories.summary: In a Femina interview, a member of the family behind Sreeleathers explains why a fashion-led footwear brand sits apart from the parent. Sreeleathers stands for quality and affordability, and a sub-category would have diluted that and limited the number of designs.

stories.title: Jewelled sandals are the season's surprise shoe trend
stories.summary: Harper's Bazaar India notes that spring summer 2027 collections gave footwear the full bijoux treatment, from rhinestone cascades to metallic flowers on glossy pumps and jewel-encrusted boots. Maximalism is back, and it has reached the feet.

stories.title: Jimmy Choo revenue rises 11.5% as shoes return to the spotlight
stories.summary: Capri Holdings says Jimmy Choo revenue rose to $146 million for the quarter ended 26 September, including $5 million from early wholesale shipments. CEO John Idol says dressier trends are building momentum at Jimmy Choo and Michael Kors.

stories.title: US footwear sales held flat in Q3
stories.summary: Circana says US footwear dollar sales were flat year over year in the third quarter while units fell in the mid-single digits. Higher average prices offset softer demand, with running shoes and select fashion items driving growth.

stories.title: Ouai and Heaven Mayhem launch refillable fragrance necklaces
stories.summary: The hair care brand and the Los Angeles jewellery label are releasing two refillable amulet necklaces at $125 each on Monday. Rue St-Honoré carries gardenia and violet notes, and Ibiza comes with a black tassel. Perfume now hangs around your neck.

stories.title: NN.07 and Clarks Originals rework the Wallabee and Desert Boot
stories.summary: The Contrast in Conversation capsule pairs full-grain leather with Scandinavian detailing, including a Desert Boot in black full-grain cowhide. It releases on 10 November through NN.07, with prices and colourways yet to be confirmed.

stories.title: Cecilie Bahnsen and The North Face return for a fourth chapter
stories.summary: The Copenhagen designer's seven-piece capsule with The North Face, first teased at her Paris Fashion Week show, reworks archive staples in black and Midnight Sky. It includes the first ever Lucia Nuptse. Gorpcore has gone delicate.

stories.title: Casio adds the CMK-100 mechanical watch
stories.summary: Casio's new CMK-100 has an automatic movement and a lightweight titanium case, built for comfort, durability and readability. It is aimed at everyday wear, work and the outdoors as interest in mechanical watches grows.

stories.title: Footwear brands are selling engineering as much as style
stories.summary: A TechBullion piece uses On, the Swiss brand known for hollow shapes in its soles, to show how running shoes are judged on design, digital shopping and credible innovation. Mexico serves as the case study for premium pricing.

stories.title: India extends the cotton duty exemption to December
stories.summary: The government has extended the customs duty exemption on cotton to the end of December, as daily arrivals stay under 70,000 bales in the new season. CITI chairman Ashwin Chandran says it helps a sector targeting $100 billion in exports by 2030.

stories.title: Textile PLI reopens for a fourth round with a lower turnover bar
stories.summary: The Ministry of Textiles reopens the PLI portal from 1 November with a two-month window for man-made fibre apparel, MMF fabrics and technical textiles. The minimum turnover condition has been cut to ₹100 crore, and earlier participants get a migration route.

stories.title: AEPC runs a TEXPORT exporter programme in Noida
stories.summary: The Ministry of Textiles and the Apparel Export Promotion Council held How to Start, Sustain and Scale Apparel Exports in Noida, the second session after Surat. It is part of the National Export Continuity Programme for new and existing exporters.

stories.title: Odisha's Pattachitra moves onto sarees and global fashion
stories.summary: Pattachitra, the cloth painting tradition tied to Puri's Jagannath temple, is now appearing on silk sarees, garments, home décor and lifestyle products. Chitrakar artists have long painted Krishna Leela and epic stories, and the shift is bringing the craft a wider audience.

stories.title: Australian wool prices post their sharpest weekly fall of the season
stories.summary: The Eastern Market Indicator dropped 62 cents, or 3.5%, to 1,723 Australian cents per kg, Australian Wool Innovation said. The pass-in rate rose to 27%, the highest since May 2023, as merino growers held back fleece.

stories.title: China leads a rise in US Upland cotton sales
stories.summary: US Upland export sales rose 8% to 216,500 running bales in the week to 22 October, with China the top buyer at 52,100. Exports fell 18%, and Pima sales dropped 95%, USDA data shows.

stories.title: Bangladesh's apparel exports to the EU fall 11.67%
stories.summary: Bangladesh's EU ready-made garment exports fell 11.67% from January to August, and its market share slipped from 21.5% to 19.8%. Spain overtook Germany as a buyer in the first quarter while China and Vietnam gained ground.

stories.title: CONFECTIONS x COLLECTIONS returns to Cape Town
stories.summary: The fifth edition runs at Mount Nelson from 5 to 7 November, co-curated with sustainability platform Twyg. Four African designers interpret the hotel's historic gardens, pairing slow fashion and craftsmanship with afternoon tea. The scones are presumably also handmade.

stories.title: WSJ reviews Doll Dressing, a book on fashion's miniature models
stories.summary: The Wall Street Journal reviews a work on fashion dolls, which date back to the 1300s, tracing dolls from bone and ivory to matryoshkas and paper chains, with a nod to Freud. The full review is for subscribers.

stories.title: eBay and Depop hit $9 billion in US fashion sales
stories.summary: eBay, which bought Depop for $1.4 billion in July, says the pair generated $9 billion in US fashion sales volume over the past year, up in the mid-20% range. Nearly 90% of Depop's 7 million active buyers were under 34.

stories.title: The RealReal posts a record quarter as GMV rises 23%
stories.summary: The luxury resale marketplace reported third quarter GMV of $642 million and revenue up 19% to $206 million, both records. Orders rose 15% to 1.02 million, the strongest growth since 2022, and the company raised its full-year guidance.

stories.title: H&M suppliers plan Indonesian factories ahead of an EU deal
stories.summary: Nine Chinese and Hong Kong supply partners of H&M will invest in new textile and garment factories in Indonesia ahead of changes to its EU trade terms. H&M's purchasing commitments to the projects remain undisclosed.

stories.title: Nachiket Barve designs clothes to wear beyond the occasion
stories.summary: The designer's Beyond the Occasion collection offers versatile separates and considered fabrics meant to outlast a single wedding or party. Barve says he does not think the world needs any more new clothes, which is a brave thing to say while launching some.

stories.title: Lowestoft's Bodhi Tree reopens after six years
stories.summary: Jolene Darrington opened the sustainable clothing store in 2015 and closed it as footfall fell in 2020, selling ethically sourced clothes and homeware at festivals since. Her daughter Eva's interest is bringing the shop back to the same building.

stories.title: Two friends road-trip Yukon's free stores for fashion
stories.summary: Textile artist Olive Siemens and filmmaker Isidore Champagne drove from Dawson City to Mount Lorne visiting free stores, where people leave goods that still have life in them. They sourced clothes and materials to make a new piece of art for free.

stories.title: Luxury needs its aspirational customers back
stories.summary: Il Sole 24 Ore reports the luxury personal goods market stagnated at €358 billion in 2025 and is expected to grow only 2% to 4% in 2026. Heritage alone no longer drives growth, it argues, and brands must win back aspirational buyers.

stories.title: Crocs raises its outlook as HeyDude returns to growth
stories.summary: Crocs third quarter revenue rose 4.6% to $1.04 billion and net income rose 48.7% to $216.8 million. HeyDude revenue grew 6.1%, and the company lifted FY26 revenue growth guidance to about 3%.

stories.title: Columbia Sportswear lifts its sales outlook after Q3
stories.summary: Net sales rose 2% to $962.6 million and net income climbed to $84.7 million from $52 million, helped by earlier wholesale shipments and better US direct sales. Columbia raised the low end of its FY26 outlook.

stories.title: AAFA asks USTR to ease trade barriers for US apparel
stories.summary: The American Apparel and Footwear Association flagged tariffs, customs delays and restrictive rules across 12 markets. It cited $28.44 billion in US tariffs paid in 2025 and asked for predictable tariffs and lower duties on inputs.

stories.title: UK retailers say the Budget does little on costs
stories.summary: The British Retail Consortium says retail faces £41 billion in business taxes this year and a 3.5% rates rise. The CBI says the Budget lacks bold moves on investment and hiring, with rates, energy and labour costs left unresolved.

stories.title: Kohl's adds Hershey's Stacy Taffet to its board
stories.summary: Kohl's has appointed Stacy Taffet, chief growth and marketing officer at The Hershey Company, as an independent director. She brings more than 20 years of consumer brand experience and will sit on the audit committee.

stories.title: Linda Fargo's first fashion job was in Macy's display department
stories.summary: The Bergdorf Goodman fashion director tells Vogue she was an art student from Wisconsin who arrived for her Macy's interview in a vintage 1940s suit after taking the subway the wrong way. Within four years she ran the windows.

stories.title: Trent's stores now cover 339 cities
stories.summary: Trent's Zudio and Westside brands occupy more than 18.5 million sq ft across 339 cities, pushing organised retail into tier two and tier three markets. Revenue rose 22% to Rs 5,873 crore in the September quarter.

stories.title: Meta quietly launches Style Sketch, an AI wardrobe app
stories.summary: The app builds a virtual wardrobe from Facebook and Instagram photos or new pictures, suggests outfits and offers virtual try-on. It is live on Android and iOS in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand. Your old posts finally have a job.

stories.title: Apparel Group launches AIVI across the Gulf
stories.summary: The retailer's AI fashion and lifestyle app combines data, loyalty and shopping across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain and Oman. It gives more than 15 million customers access to over 200,000 styles and products.

stories.title: High street brands stage a comeback with stars and AI stylists
stories.summary: The Guardian looks at Gap's Victoria Beckham collection, M&S's buy-now catwalk at London Fashion Week with half the pieces under £50, and Topshop's concessions in 30 John Lewis stores. The noughties are back, now with stylists that run on software.

stories.title: Online fashion brands are moving into physical stores
stories.summary: Australian online labels such as Princess Polly are opening shops on the Gold Coast and in Brisbane even as legacy brands collapse. Executives say online and in-store are merging, and experts expect more e-commerce brands to follow.

stories.title: ABB adds an AI trainer to its fashion picking robot
stories.summary: ABB Robotics has upgraded its Fashion Inductor module with an AI Robot Trainer, which it says cuts engineering and commissioning effort by up to 75%. The system targets the constant variability of apparel logistics.

stories.title: US shoppers are holding out for Thanksgiving weekend
stories.summary: NRF found 64% of consumers are likely to wait until Thanksgiving weekend for most holiday shopping, up from 51% five years ago. NRF forecasts holiday sales up 4.2% to $1.013 trillion, while online intent is the lowest since 2015.

stories.title: H&M opens its first Malta store on 14 November
stories.summary: H&M enters Malta with a store on Tower Road in Sliema, opening on 14 November, local partner Hudson Holdings said. The store will carry the brand's fashion and lifestyle collections in a modern retail concept.

stories.title: ELLE Graduates 2026 is open to emerging Indian labels
stories.summary: ELLE India's platform for new fashion talent, which has featured Ruchika Sachdeva, Dhruv Kapoor and Ujjawal Dubey, is taking applications. Labels working in Indian wear, Western silhouettes, menswear, accessories or sustainable fashion can apply to showcase their latest collection.

stories.title: Indigenous Storytellers Scholarship opens for 2027
stories.summary: Created by Façon Australia with Greater Bank, the scholarship for First Nations creatives in NSW is open until 7 March 2027. The winner receives $10,000, each of the eight other finalists gets $1,000, and Samantha Harris is the 2027 ambassador.

stories.title: Fashion and beauty brands run programmes for women founders and students
stories.summary: A guide compares programmes run by fashion and beauty brands and their foundations, from Tory Burch onward, covering grants, coaching, student mentorship and research funding. Some accept direct applications while others work through nonprofits, so check each official site.
